status: Frozen before new judge outputs were inspected
purpose: Test robustness of textual-event measurements and key behavioral contrasts across judge families; not independent human validity
judge_selection: Three distinct cached model families; heterogeneous capacities disclosed. No majority-vote gold standard.
prompts: Unchanged repository indexed-sentence Kim and Gandhi templates, hashed in sample manifest
sample: All seven atlas models and eight domains; random attempts plus unfinished enrichment with known union inclusion probabilities; paired intervention and matched-demand samples
window: First 2048 units of the Qwen3.5-9B tokenizer for all models; empty and shorter prefixes retained in coverage accounting
blinding: Prompts and reasoning text only. Original labels, outcome scores, treatment names, and generator names withheld; text may reveal its source.
primary_analysis: Pairwise label agreement and prevalence differences with trace-cluster uncertainty
Inverse-inclusion-weighted domain profiles with per-judge-valid and common-valid-segment sensitivity
Paired intervention shifts separately under each judge
Solve/generate/evaluate/MCQ contrasts separately under each judge
analysis_clarification: Before GPU annotation began, removed an unimplemented unweighted first-draw sensitivity from the analysis inventory. Weighted union-sample rates remain primary; the frozen sample and annotation templates are unchanged.
missingness: Parse failures are missing, never negative labels. Report failure rates per judge and domain; common-valid and all-available sensitivities.
pilot: One trace per source, generator, and domain before full run. Inspect schema completion and absence of silent all-zero or truncated output; do not select a judge by agreement with Gemma.
scope_limit: Fixed-prefix robustness sample does not replace the full-trace atlas or establish exhaustive psychological processes. Rare-label coverage and uncertainty are reported.
